execution_hints: Create one deterministic Python script in the current workspace root and run it once to produce and check all six artifacts; do not place helper files under outputs.

Do not install or probe for optional spatial-statistics packages and do not write to an operating-system temporary directory; use the Python standard library plus an already importable numeric package if desired.
Write text artifacts explicitly as UTF-8 and keep generated source ASCII-safe on Windows by using Unicode escape sequences when needed.
Implement the declared small dense linear algebra directly or with an already available numeric package; no SciPy, PySAL, statsmodels, or network access is required.
method_contract: Fit global OLS first with an intercept and final predictors green_share and income_index; evaluate green_share_proxy in the VIF set and exclude it under the declared VIF gate.

Build row-standardized queen primary and rook sensitivity lattice neighbors, calculate Moran's I on residuals, and run the fixture's seeded two-sided permutation test using (exceedances+1)/(permutations+1).
Use four contiguous 6-by-6 folds in the deterministic order NE, NW, SE, SW; fit every model and preprocessing step on training areas only and score prediction minus observation.
Fit Gaussian local weighted regressions with weight exp(-0.5*(distance_m/bandwidth_m)^2), an intercept, and the same two final predictors; compute effective sample size as 1/sum(normalized_weight^2).

Compute weighted coefficient covariance from weighted SSE divided by max(sum(weights)-parameter_count,1), derive normal-approximation p-values with erfc, and adjust the local green-share p-values with Benjamini-Hochberg.
Mark a local estimate stable only when effective sample size meets the fixture minimum and the one-norm condition number of X'WX is at most 100000.
Select the local model only when both fixture decision gates pass: primary OLS residual Moran significance and minimum blocked-RMSE improvement; otherwise select global OLS.
Treat all coefficient maps as exploratory spatial associations, never causal effects, and preserve the registered bandwidth, units, inference seed, permutation count, and decision gates.
